concept.material: dark carved burl walnut and aged sterling silver
concept.internal_detail: microscopic silver escapement wheels and coiled steel hairs
concept.button: a small silver stud embedded in the woody grain
concept.button_short: the small silver stud embedded in the wooden grain
concept.shell_mechanic: The walnut ellipsoid splits down the middle and the two carved halves peel backward like folding leaves
concept.emerging_parts: Four jointed silver legs and a long flexible tail segment
concept.signature_move: its silver tail segment swings from side to side once on its base hinge with a dry click
concept.turkish: fossa: Fossa (Madagaskar'da yasayan, kedi benzeri yirtici memeli) — dilimli ceviz elipsoidi, koyu oymali kok ceviz ve eskitilmis gumus

concept.material: antique cast iron with gilded brass hinges
concept.internal_detail: interlocking micro-cogs and delicate tension springs
concept.button: a tiny iron lever shaped like a drop
concept.shell_mechanic: The pleated iron fan spreads wide along its radial pivots and the ribbed segments fan outward
concept.emerging_parts: A hinged crest plate, two slender jointed legs, and a rigid beak assembly
concept.signature_move: its hinged crest plate bobs up and down on its pivot and its brass beak assembly opens and clicks shut
concept.turkish: great blue turaco: Buyuk mavi turako (Afrika'da yasayan, renkli tuy baslikli bir kus) — kirisik katlanir yelpaze, antik dokme demir ve yaldizli pirinc mentefeler
